verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical broken layouts. The photo is cut into a narrow center strip with large white dead areas on both sides, and the white cloud shapes float detached on the white left side, where they are almost invisible. A white text box chops off the lower half of the photo and hides the hands, which were the main image. The quote is readable but sits off-center to the right, and nothing lines up on a clear grid. The only difference is the cross: in A it sits slightly higher and stands out more clearly against the dark photo, while B's cross is lost on the hands, so A wins by a hair.
